_meta.purpose: Hand-curated aliases mapping Indian-script names to canonical English district/state/scheme keys, so ingest_news.py can auto-anchor non-Latin headlines (Bengali/Hindi/Tamil/Telugu/Marathi) instead of dropping them as 'unanchored'.
_meta.why_hand_curated: Machine transliteration produces false matches; the project's whole philosophy rejects false precision. These are deliberately verified mappings, not algorithmic guesses. Auto-anchors are still only SUGGESTIONS — every item is human-confirmed in curate.html before display.
_meta.how_used: ingest_news.py does substring containment for script values (Indian scripts have no .lower() and Latin \b word-boundaries don't apply). Resolves to the same canonical keys as district-ledger.json states/districts and _meta.scheme_registry.
_meta.coverage_note: Seeded for states our feeds serve (WB/bn, Bihar+Hindi-belt/hi, TN/ta, AP-TG/te, MH/mr). Extend freely — a missing alias just means that headline stays unanchored for manual curation, never a wrong anchor.
_meta.scheme_resolution: scheme aliases map to scheme_registry keys (e.g. MGNREGS). state/district map to the canonical English names used in district-ledger.json.
